features.title: Books & pages
lines: Notebook spaces for months, trips, and projects.
Related pages belong together in books.

features.title: Expenses & income
lines: Everyday spending and earnings in one record.
Amounts, dates, and accounts stay connected.

features.title: Quick & prompt entry
lines: Compact fields or structured prompt input.
Suggested details remain editable before saving.

features.title: Accounts & sub-accounts
lines: Cash, cards, bank, and mobile banking records.
Sub-accounts add another layer of organization.

features.title: Transfers & exchanges
lines: Money movements between recorded accounts.
Both sides appear in balances and statements.

features.title: Multiple currencies
lines: Currency-specific records and balances.
Spending analysis retains its currency context.

features.title: Loans & repayments
lines: Money lent and borrowed, organized by contact.
Repayments and history accompany each loan.

features.title: Tags & notes
lines: Categories and context alongside transactions.
Tagged records connect to budgets and analysis.

features.title: Flexible budgets
lines: Weekly, monthly, and yearly spending limits.
Overall and category progress show what remains.

features.title: Savings goals
lines: Targets, deadlines, and regular saving plans.
Emergency funds and future costs have a place too.

features.title: Scheduled expenses
lines: Due dates and recurrence for expected costs.
Payment records and reminders follow each period.

features.title: Planned spending
lines: To-do pages hold intended expenses.
Completed items connect to transaction entry.

features.title: Dashboard & charts
lines: Summaries and trends across recorded activity.
Period breakdowns reveal spending patterns.

features.title: Search & filters
lines: Transaction search with flexible filter chips.
Matching records explain the figures behind totals.

features.title: Statements & history
lines: Account statements and balance history.
Related movements keep their financial context.

features.title: Connected accounting
lines: A double-entry foundation connects records.
Account movements and balances belong together.

features.title: Local & offline records
lines: Personal records live in the app’s local database.
Everyday recordkeeping is available offline.

features.title: Backup & restore
lines: Local backup files preserve personal records.
Restore is available during app setup.

features.title: App password & lock
lines: Password protection for access to the app.
Automatic lock timing fits recording habits.

features.title: Language & preferences
lines: App language, currency, and entry defaults.
Daily entry reminders support a regular habit.

features.title: Cloud sync
lines: Personal records synchronized across Android devices.
Sync status reflects available online access.

features.title: Voice & image entry
lines: Recognition from voice notes and selected images.
Extracted transaction details remain editable.

features.title: Cartera assistant
lines: Record lookups and summaries through chat.
Supported records and plans can be created or edited.

features.title: Automatic tagging
lines: AI category tags for eligible transactions.
Availability follows configuration and allowances.

features.title: Shared costs & settlements
lines: Group expenses with equal or custom shares.
Recorded settlements explain who owes whom.

features.title: Shared funds
lines: Contributions and expenses in a group fund.
Balances and activity connect members’ records.

features.title: Dues & collections
lines: Recurring charges and full or partial payment records.
Member and customer statements show what is owed.

features.title: Group access & history
lines: Membership and permissions shape shared access.
Group activity preserves a shared financial record.
